label: 9. You need to put a stop to Vesti and Emma.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You need to put a stop to Vesti and Emma.
Where's this coming from?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I went along with that dumb pajama party,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: and now they're talking about some beauty thing?
What beauty thing?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: First we're supposed to apply makeup on each other.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Then we recommend outfits we think look good.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: So not only do we have to get made up, but we have to wear whichever outfit gets chosen.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Can you imagine anything more horrible?
I dunno, sounds kinda fun to me.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You actually think this is fun? =.=

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Actually, that's great.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You can join instead of me.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I'm sure those two would love that.
Nah, they'd probably be disappointed if you back out.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: They'll manage.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Honestly, I don't get why we have to do these pointless events every single day off.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: They say

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: it's for team-building,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: but how exactly is this supposed to help with anything?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Real bonding happens

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: through constructive talks

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: and planning strategies that actually aid our missions.
Sounds a bit dry.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That all you've got to say, Junior Blockhead?
You know majority rules, right?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Obviously.
Well, Emma and Vesti have the majority vote, so you've got to play along.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I'm starting to regret bringing this up.
So, when's that supposed to happen?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What do you mean "that"?
That beauty thing.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Our next day off.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Why do you ask?
Because I want to watch too.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Cut the crap.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: If you come, I'll kill you.
After that, Eunhwa doesn't reply anymore.
